title: Mysterious man plays Ransone a metallic ET voice tape

tellings.quote: or something. And he gets a tape cassette, puts it in the car, and the tape cassette starts and it's a voice, a metallic voice,

plain: Sometime in the early 1970s in Houston, a woman named Valerie Ransone is said to have been handed a cassette by a mysterious man. When it played in the car, it was a metallic voice that she took to be from beings not of Earth. An unnamed researcher passes this on from what Ransone said in an interview on the YouTube channel Eyes on Cinema, as a sign that someone was delivering alien messages by tape.
